name: flutter-plugin
description: Flutter stack provider for the SDLC marketplace (priority=300). Detects pubspec.yaml depending on sdk: flutter and claims both backend and frontend aspects, so it wins over dart-plugin on every Flutter project. Covers mobile, web and desktop targets: widget composition, theming, state management (Riverpod / Bloc / Provider — matches what is installed), go_router / Navigator navigation with deep links, platform channels and secure storage, widget / golden / integration_test testing. Adds flutter-architect agent (Sonnet/medium). Reuses Dart skills from dart-foundation.
